description: Checks whether one employer job posting is still open, for questions like “is this job still taking applications?”: url is the https link to the employer's posting. Returns open, closed, unknown (a posting Applystead does not track) or unsupported (not a posting link Applystead reads), as of Applystead's last read (the link itself is not fetched), with a tracked posting's title, company and Applystead job page, and an open one's listed pay and Apply with Applystead link. Apply with Applystead opens an Applystead account that tailors a résumé to a job and prepares applications for the person.

url.description: The https link to the employer's job posting.

name: check_job_posting
title: Check a job posting
